name: PMC Fincorp Limited
about: PMC Fincorp Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company offers working capital solutions; and business loans and loans against securities. It engages in financing and investment related activities. The company was formerly known as Priti Mercantile Company Limited and changed its name to PMC Fincorp Limited in March 2014. PMC Fincorp Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in New Delhi, India.
